cases.name: Margaret "Peggy" Clarke
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Peggy was a hardworking, caring, and loving person. She was a dedicated wife, mother and grandmother. She enjoyed spending time with family and friends and excelled at many different hand crafts, including beading, sewing, crochet, and knitting. She was also known for her wonderful baked goods. Peggy belonged to a bowling league for several years at Sunset Lanes, which ended in her making and maintaining many wonderful friendships." Peggy is predeceased by her siblings, Pauline Rock, Paul Blaine, Rosalie Reynolds, Henry Blaine, and William Blaine. She is survived by her husband, Graham Clarke, daughters, Kaara Gonyo and her husband Roger, Darlene Reid and her husband John, four grandsons, Kyle and Kraig Gonyo, and Timothy and Bradley Reid, and a brother, James Blaine. She is also survived by six great-grandchildren and several nieces and nephews.
